page.overview:
Who is Alister?

Alister is a playable Legendary Duelist in Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links. This is a video game depiction of Alister, a character from the Yu-Gi-Oh! anime.

He first appeared on March 30, 2026 during his dedicated event "The New Pulse of Darkness! Alister is Here!" and he became unlockable on March 31, 2026.

One of the leaders of Doma - a secret society that has manipulated history since the dawn of time. After losing his brother Mikey to war, he blames KaibaCorp - and the current CEO Seto Kaiba - for supplying the weaponry used in battle. As a master of disguise, he enters Kaiba's inner circle to plot his revenge. He attempts to seal Kaiba's soul away by using "The Seal of Orichalcos" and defeating him in a Duel.

When dueling against Level 40 Alister, these are the only cards that can drop; at lower levels, cards from the standard pool for Legendary Duelists may also drop.
